required_concepts: Square is a type of rectangle
Both are quadrilaterals with four right angles
optional_concepts: Opposite sides are equal in rectangles
critical_errors: Treat square and rectangle as separate categories
misconceptions: Think rectangles must have all sides equal
Confuse square properties with rectangle properties
grading_notes: Award full credit for recognizing square as a special case of rectangle. Penalize only if student explicitly separates them into distinct categories. Accept variations in terminology as long as core relationship is correct.
